extension.summary: SHK-005 dev.1 - Artwork Glass development candidate
extension.description: SHK-005 dev.1 development candidate: artwork-responsive glass surfaces, controller navigation, TV Guide and Favourites, Movies and Series shelves, title details, custom dialogs and playback controls. Optional automatic opening and the Android-reference white eclipse animation. Connection changes require a local four-digit passcode. Privacy shortcut is Coming soon. Retains the .57 playback and account adapter, including existing provider permissions, restoration, history and preferences. No channels or subscriptions are supplied. Native Kodi/Xbox visual and hardware acceptance is required before release.
